title: Data and supplemental material of the paper "Effectiveness of digital-based interventions for children with mathematical learning difficulties: A meta-analysis".

evidence.reason: Inventory must identify exactly k distinct trials

adjudication.design_quote: The aim of the meta-analysis was to evaluate the effects of digital-based interventions for children with mathematical learning difficulties compared to control conditions in a group-designed randomized controlled trials.
adjudication.k_quote: Given these characteristics of the control group results of this study were not included in the final meta-analysis.
adjudication.reason: Pairwise meta-analysis of group-designed RCTs (intervention vs control); 15 selected studies of which two (Kucian, Rasanen) were dropped from the final meta-analysis, leaving 13 (either 13 or 15 is within 3-25).
